title: Today
heading: What should we do today?
moneyLeftSentence: This is what is left of this month's budget for buying new shares.
moneyLeftHow: The budget set for this month, minus what we have bought so far this month.
moneyLeftNone: No budget is set for this month, so there is no figure to show.
breadthSentence: Out of the biggest {n} shares, this many are above their own 200-day average price.
breadthHow: We count the biggest shares trading above their average price of the last 200 days, and divide by how many we counted.
trendUp: The Nifty is above its 200-day average: the market is in an upward trend.
trendDown: The Nifty is below its 200-day average: the market is in a downward trend.
trendHow: The Nifty's closing level compared with its average of the last 200 days.
valueSentence: The middle share, by price against profit, looks {band} today.
valueHow: We take the price-to-profit ratio (P/E) of every share that makes a profit and look at the middle one.
groupsNote: Only stocks we hold or watch are listed.
